title: Ownership chart and signed control declaration
definition: The customer's own ownership chart, together with a signed declaration identifying the natural persons who own or control the entity and the basis of their control. It is requested alongside, or in place of, a register extract, and it establishes what the customer asserts, which is only as good as the declaration's evidential basis.
evidence_to_cite: the ownership chart, with the date it was produced
the signed declaration, and the identity of the signatory and their authority
the basis of control asserted for each owner

sources.citation: Beneficial ownership identification and certification requirements, summarised in the FinCrime regulatory index.
